2024-09-15
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured vehicle was struck from
behind while stopped, and the insured reports the other driver was at fault.
2024-10-13
Reviewed the poilcy and confirmed the driver involved is named on the policy and coverage was in force at the time
of the loss. No issues with the policy period noted.
2024-10-23
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement both describe the same sequence of events. A witness at the
scene also confirmed the impact happened as the insured described.
2024-10-29
Inspected the insured vehicle. The rear bumper, trunk lid and tail light damage is consistent with the reported impact.
No prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records reviewed.
2024-11-14
Claimant has retanied counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office. Claimant reports a wrist
fracture from the collision.
2024-12-02
Claimant did not provide a name to anyone at the scene, and the claimant first came into the calim several days after
the accident. The claim file was opened on the basis of the insured's report and the other driver's statement.
2025-01-14
Medical records reviewed. The wrist fracture is consistent with the type and force of a rear-end impact. No prior injury
to the same wrist or arm appears in the records obtained so far.
2025-02-05
Treatment followed a typical course, with follow-up visits spaced out as healing progressed. Treatment has tapered
off as the claimant improved, and the provider's notes reflect steady recovery.
2025-03-06
Claimant's counsel provided an updated account that adds a few smlal details not in the first statement. The core
account of the collision is unchanged from the original report.
2025-03-21
File reviewed. Liability and vehicle damage remain consistent with the reported loss, and the injury treatment is
progressing as expected. Next step is to continue evaluating the bodily injury component through counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
